content.title: Barrick Hands Hemlo Gold Mine To New Owner In $1.09 Billion Deal
content.summary: Barrick Mining Corporation (NYSE:B) announced Wednesday that it has struck a deal to divest its Hemlo Gold Mine in Ontario, Canada, in a transaction worth as much as $1.09 billion. The mine will be acquired by Carcetti Capital Corp., which plans to rename itself Hemlo Mining Corp. once the sale closes.
